faq: Is the theme included in the price?
Free themes are included. If a paid premium theme suits you better, we tell you the license price first, and you buy it in your own name so it is yours.
Can I pick the theme myself?
Yes. Send a link and we check that it is fast, maintained and fits your content. If it is not a good choice, we explain why and suggest alternatives.
Will the site look exactly like the demo?
Close, but with your own logo, colors, text and photos. Demos use sample images, so the final look depends on your content, which we help you shape.
What if I want more changes later?
Small edits you can do yourself in the editor. For bigger changes, our theme edits service handles layout work in a child theme so updates never overwrite it.

desc:
Not every site needs a custom build. Ecom Swift LLC provides ready-made WordPress theme setup: we choose an editor-friendly theme, install it and fill it with your logo, colors, text and photos so you can launch quickly.

## What is a ready-made WordPress theme setup?

A WordPress theme controls the look and layout of a site. A ready-made theme comes with demo pages, so you do not design from nothing. A setup service picks a theme that fits your business, installs it, matches the demo to your content and shows you how to edit it.

You get a finished-looking site faster than a custom design allows, and at a lower cost.

## Why a good setup beats installing alone

Installing a theme takes a minute. Making it look like the demo takes hours of small decisions: which demo to import, how to set menus, which header style to use, what to do with unused sections and how images should be cropped. Many owners stop halfway and end up with a site that looks neither like the demo nor like their brand.

Starting with a suitable theme, set up carefully, avoids that gap. It also avoids themes packed with options that slow the site down.

## How the setup helps your business

Speed to launch is the main benefit. A good theme saves weeks, so you can start sharing your site, collecting enquiries and testing your message sooner. A clean layout built on a well-made theme is usually easy to update, because the block editor lets you change text and images without code.

A budget-friendly setup also leaves room to grow. If you later want a custom design, your content is already in place. What you get depends on the theme and the content you provide, so we match the two carefully.

## What a proper theme setup includes

- A theme chosen with you, based on your business, content and editing comfort.
- Installation and activation, with unused demo content removed.
- Brand look from your logo, palette and typefaces applied site wide.
- A home page filled with your own text and images.
- Menu, header and footer arranged for easy navigation.
- Extra pages built from the demo layouts.
- A contact form and a blog layout, where needed.
- Mobile settings checked on a real phone.
- Search titles and basic speed settings in larger packages.
- A short video that shows how to edit pages.

## How we do it

We start by asking what you sell, who your visitors are and which pages you need. We then suggest a theme and explain why it fits. You can also pick the theme yourself, and we tell you if it suits the plan.

After installation, we set up the demo layout and replace placeholder text and photos with yours. We configure the menu and footer, check mobile behavior and record a short guide on editing. Basic covers the theme and the home page. Standard adds several pages, a form and a blog. Premium adds light custom styling, search titles, speed settings and backups. Add-ons include extra pages, your logo in web formats and a newsletter signup.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Choose a theme with good reviews and regular updates.
- Gather your logo, photos and text before the setup.
- Keep your site close to the demo layout.
- Use the block editor rather than adding many extra tools.
- Ask for more changes only after the first setup is live.

**Avoid:**
- Importing every demo page and deleting most of them.
- Picking a theme only because the demo has animations.
- Adding a page builder on top of a theme that already has one.
- Using photos that are far too large.
- Expecting the site to match the demo photo for photo.

## Who it is for

Start-ups with a small budget can launch with a professional-looking site. Freelancers who want to manage their own pages will appreciate the block editor. Local businesses that need a simple site quickly, without a long design phase, can use it as a first step.

## How to get started

Send a short description of your business, your logo and colors if you have them, and examples of sites you like. We never ask for passwords. We work through an administrator or collaborator user in your WordPress account. Paid themes are bought by you directly, and our package covers the setup work only.
